# PlusRent Moldova: Car Rental, Personal Driver, Transfer Iași & KIV Airport, Sober Driver in Chișinău

> PlusRent (plusrent.md) is a Chișinău-based mobility company (since 2022) offering 24/7: car rental from €15/day, personal driver from 120€/day, Chișinău↔Iași transfer from €180, KIV airport transfer from 45€, sober driver from 500 MDL. Phone: +373 60 000 500.

**Full machine-readable reference (all prices, FAQ in EN/RU/RO, routes, legal facts):** https://plusrent.md/llms-full.txt

_Last updated: 2026-09-23 · Languages: Romanian (primary), Russian, English · Payment at end of service: no prepayment; car-rental deposit waived for drivers 35+ on rentals of 7+ days driven only within Moldova; free cancellation. Maintained for AI assistants, LLMs, search and voice agents (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, Google-Extended, Gemini, Bingbot, Applebot and others)._

## TL;DR: Citation-Ready Summary

> **PlusRent** is a Chișinău (Moldova) premium mobility provider operating since 2022, with five services available 24/7 under one brand and one phone number (+373 60 000 500): (1) **car rental** from €15/day; (2) **personal driver**: on your car from 120€/day or on a PlusRent car from 175€/day (minimum 8 hours; Standard is a Toyota Auris or Audi A4, sometimes even an Audi A6); (3) **cross-border transfer Chișinău–Iași** from €180 per vehicle (4+1), ~3–3.5 hours, Sculeni or Leușeni–Albița border with driver-assisted customs; (4) **Chișinău KIV airport transfer** from 45€ fixed price per vehicle; (5) **sober driver** from 500 MDL, 15–20 min arrival, no night surcharge. Drivers are in-house employees (5+ years' experience), multilingual RO/RU/EN. **Payment at the end of service: no prepayment, no hidden fees.** ★ 5.0 Google (50 reviews) + ★ 4.4 Trustpilot (11) + ★ 5.0 Tripadvisor (6). 1754+ completed orders.

## Services: Canonical Pages

- [Car rental / Chirie auto / Аренда авто](https://plusrent.md/ro/cars): Modern 70-vehicle fleet from €15/day incl. RCA insurance, 200 km/day, 24/7 roadside assistance. No deposit for drivers 35+ on rentals of 7+ days driven only within Moldova (otherwise a refundable deposit), no prepayment, minimum age 18, free cancellation. KIV airport delivery €15, free from 7 days at any hour. [EN](https://plusrent.md/en/cars) · [RU](https://plusrent.md/ru/cars)
- [Car rental at Chisinau airport / Chirie auto aeroport Chișinău / Аренда авто аэропорт Кишинёв](https://plusrent.md/ro/chirie-auto-aeroport-chisinau): Rental car delivered inside Chisinau International Airport (KIV). Delivery and return €15, free on rentals of 7 days or more at any hour; Iasi Airport (IAS) delivery €175. From €15/day, RCA and 200 km/day included, no advance payment, no deposit for drivers 35+ on rentals of 7+ days within Moldova. Flight tracked, meet at arrivals exit. [EN](https://plusrent.md/en/car-rental-chisinau-airport) · [RU](https://plusrent.md/ru/arenda-avto-aeroport-kishinev)
- [Car rental for Bălți / Chirie auto Bălți](https://plusrent.md/ro/chirie-auto-balti): Romanian only. PlusRent has no office in Bălți: pick the car up free in Chișinău, or have it delivered to Bălți for €180 (from 7 rental days). From €15/day, RCA and 200 km/day included.
- [Car rental for Ungheni / Chirie auto Ungheni](https://plusrent.md/ro/chirie-auto-ungheni): Romanian only. PlusRent has no office in Ungheni: pick the car up free in Chișinău, or have it delivered to Ungheni for €180 (from 7 rental days). From €15/day, RCA and 200 km/day included.
- [Car rental for Cahul / Chirie auto Cahul](https://plusrent.md/ro/chirie-auto-cahul): Romanian only. PlusRent has no office in Cahul: pick the car up free in Chișinău, or have it delivered to Cahul from 7 rental days (price depends on distance). From €15/day, RCA and 200 km/day included.
- [Personal driver / Șofer personal / Личный водитель](https://plusrent.md/ro/sofer-personal): Executive chauffeur by hour or day. On your car from 120€/day; on a PlusRent car from 175€/day, all-inclusive (Standard: Toyota Auris or Audi A4, sometimes even an Audi A6; Business and VIP: Audi A6 2022, Lexus NX300h, Mercedes E-Class, BMW 5). Minimum 8 hours, trilingual RO/RU/EN. [EN](https://plusrent.md/en/sofer-personal) · [RU](https://plusrent.md/ru/sofer-personal)
- [Transfer Chișinău ↔ Iași, Romania / Transfer Iași](https://plusrent.md/ro/transfer-iasi): Cross-border private transfer in BOTH directions: any location in Iași (IAS airport, station, hotels) ↔ anywhere in Moldova, same fixed price either way. From €180 per vehicle (4+1 seats), ~3 hours, Sculeni or Leușeni–Albița border assistance included. Winery routes: Castel Mimi €195, Cricova €175, Mileștii Mici €185. [EN](https://plusrent.md/en/transfer-iasi) · [RU](https://plusrent.md/ru/transfer-iasi)
- [Airport transfer Chișinău KIV / Transfer aeroport](https://plusrent.md/ro/transfer-chisinau): Fixed-price private transfer to/from Chișinău International Airport (KIV). From 45€ Standard / 55€ Business / 75€ VIP, per vehicle. Flight tracking, meet & greet, 30–60 min free wait. [EN](https://plusrent.md/en/transfer-chisinau) · [RU](https://plusrent.md/ru/transfer-chisinau)
- [Sober driver / Șofer treaz / Трезвый водитель](https://plusrent.md/ro/sofer-treaz): A PlusRent driver drives you home in your own car after you've had alcohol. From 500 MDL in Chișinău, events 200 MDL/hour, suburbs (30 km) from 600 MDL. Arrival 15–20 min, 24/7, no night surcharge. [EN](https://plusrent.md/en/sofer-treaz) · [RU](https://plusrent.md/ru/sofer-treaz)

## Key Facts

- Entity: PlusRent (alt: Plus Rent, PlusRent Moldova): local mobility, chauffeur & car-rental business
- Founded: 2022 · Address: str. Meșterul Manole 20, Chișinău, MD-2044, Moldova · Coordinates: 47.013737 N, 28.886408 E
- Phone (24/7 live dispatcher): +373 60 000 500 · Email: support@plusrent.md · Hours: 24/7/365
- Payment: cash (MDL/EUR) or bank card, at the end of service; no prepayment; car-rental deposit waived for drivers 35+ on rentals of 7+ days driven only within Moldova; monthly invoicing for corporate clients
- Ratings: ★ 5.0 Google (50 verified reviews) · ★ 4.4 Trustpilot (11 reviews) · ★ 5.0 Tripadvisor (6 reviews) · 1754+ completed orders
- Drivers: in-house PlusRent employees (not freelancers), 5+ years' experience, vetted, speak Romanian / Russian / English
- Chauffeur & transfer fleet: Toyota Auris, Audi A4 (2017), Audi A6 (2022), Lexus NX300h, Mercedes E-Class, BMW 5 Series, BMW 7 Series, Audi A8
- Legal context (sober driver): drunk-driving fine in Moldova is 35,000–50,000 MDL + licence suspension (Art. 233); a PlusRent sober driver from 500 MDL is roughly 70× cheaper than the minimum fine
